page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 Broadwell processor operating at 2.5 GHz with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores. The instance features 30 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB per vCPU, alongside 472 GB of local SSD storage and 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Accelerator hardware includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU configured with 16 GB of VRAM.

Performance data indicates a contrast between host CPU performance and GPU acceleration. The underlying Intel Broadwell CPU displays lower single-core (952.78) and multi-core (2375.81) stress-ng benchmark scores, alongside constrained memory bandwidth of 19.43 GB/sec for large block uncached reads. Conversely, the dedicated NVIDIA P100 GPU delivers high inference throughput. Small model 135M prompt processing achieves 9863.53 tokens/sec, while medium model 7B prompt processing reaches 316.25 tokens/sec with text generation speeds of 42.76 tokens/sec.

Architecturally, the server prioritizes dedicated GPU capability over CPU compute density. The allocation of 472 GB of local SSD storage ensures high local data access speeds for dataset storage. The resource layout makes this instance best suited for small to medium LLM inference, machine learning model testing, deep learning evaluation, and general GPU-accelerated computational tasks rather than CPU-heavy relational databases or general-purpose web applications.
